verdict.rationale: Bevy has no editor. The pack's only nod toward an external, programmatic control interface is a passing probe mention of the first-party Bevy Remote Protocol, which the community bevy_brp tool builds on. That suggests an agent could reach running ECS worlds, while the Scene system (create/save/load worlds) and the code-first cargo workflow cover project work through code rather than through a dedicated agent-facing interface. Missing for 10: documented BRP capabilities (creating entities/scenes, editing components remotely), an editor or official scripting/automation API, an agent-triggered build interface, an official MCP, and hands-on corroboration.
